newsitem.title: UK: RJB Mining extends recovery, BZW rates buy.
newsitem.headline: RJB Mining extends recovery, BZW rates buy.

text.p: Shares in RJB Mining Plc continued their steady recovery on Friday after the stock was sent plummeting last Tuesday on the back of an earnings forecast reduction by brokerage BZW.
Shares were up 17p at 415p by 0902 in volume of 62,957. On Tuesday, the stock dropped 112-1/2p after BZW cut its 1997 and 1998 earnings forecasts by 16 percent and 20 percent respectively.
Traders said BZW had rated the stock a "buy" following the stock's decline, arguing that its current rating was attractive and that RJB's cash flow remained strong.
Analysts at the brokerage were not immediately available for comment.
